title: Spec's Suggested Review Order line anchors for form_stepper.js are stale after the r1 fix commit
evidence:
Spec: "- Entry point: progressive-enhancement choreography — activation gates, form.js probe, section model.
  [`form_stepper.js:221`](../../server/priv/static/form_stepper.js#L221)" and "[`form_stepper.js:406`](../../server/priv/static/form_stepper.js#L406)", "[`form_stepper.js:185`](...#L185)", "[`form_stepper.js:345`](...#L345)". Actual worktree grep: "284:  function initBrowser() {", "473:    function onContinue() {", "235:  function firstErrorIndex(sectionEls, opts) {", "411:    function markInvalid(controls) {" — line 221 sits inside focusTargetFor, 406 inside show().
detail: The review map (added in 61fd895) predates the r1 fixes (7ac11fe) which reshaped the file; four of six stepper anchors now land on unrelated code, misleading every reviewer the spec directs.
recommended_fix: Re-point the anchors to the current lines (284/473/235/411) or drop the #L fragments and reference function names only.

title: Committed diff.txt header misattributes the r0 snapshot to sha a8b2cf9
evidence: Header: "# r0 REVIEW SNAPSHOT — frozen at sha a8b2cf9 (2026-08-01, pre-r1-fixes)". Embedded code: "+          var target = resolveFieldElement(doc, id);". But `git show a8b2cf9:server/priv/static/form_stepper.js` line 514 reads "          var target = resolveAnchorTarget(doc, a.getAttribute(\"href\"));" and line 153 has the gdpr_consent mapping — a8b2cf9 already contains the swarm fixes.
detail: a8b2cf9 is the squash commit that folded the r0 fixes in; the embedded diff is the pre-squash state the swarm actually reviewed. The 'do not treat as current code' labelling is good, but the sha reference points at a tree that does not match the snapshot.
recommended_fix: Reword the header, e.g. "frozen from the pre-squash r0 branch (reviewed state; fixes later folded into a8b2cf9)".

title: blind-hunter.md carries no banner marking its 11 findings as an r0 record fixed in the shipped branch
evidence:
File opens: "# Blind Hunter — adversarial review, form-stepper-f1

Reviewed cold against the diff, the spec of record, and the on-disk source" then "1. **Blocker — `.gitignore:31` — `form_stepper.js` is git-ignored; the feature never ships.**" — while the shipped .gitignore:37 reads "!server/priv/static/form_stepper.js". Only the sibling diff.txt header explains the findings "were fixed in the shipped branch".
detail: A reader landing on this file directly (grep for 'Blocker', editor browse) sees apparently-live findings against code that has since changed; the fixed-in-branch context exists only one hop away in diff.txt.
recommended_fix: Add a two-line header banner to blind-hunter.md (and edge-hunter.md) mirroring diff.txt's: r0 record, findings fixed in the shipped branch, not current code.

title: Spec task checkbox claims an F3-SEAM test pin that does not exist
evidence: Spec: "- [x] `server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam` — pin: 8 sections visible (no `hidden` on fieldsets), ids in order, details closed pristine/open prefilled, `listing_source` absent, F5 helpers present, script tag present, prep block + F3-SEAM substring intact." Grep of server/test (and client/shared/scripts test dirs) for F3-SEAM finds nothing; the only prep pin is "server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam:324:  |> string.contains(\"data-testid=\\\"apply-prep-block\\\"\")".
detail: The checked-off task overclaims: the prep block is pinned but no F3-SEAM substring pin was written — and cannot be via SSR HTML, since F3-SEAM is a Gleam source comment (form_view.gleam:121), never rendered.
recommended_fix: Correct the task text to reflect what is actually pinned (prep block testid), noting the F3-SEAM comment is preserved by inspection/diff review, not by a test.

title: Frozen boundary says 'form.js untouched' but the branch edits form.js
evidence: Spec frozen 'Always' list: "- `data-section-id` values + section DOM order unchanged (funnel keys off them); `apply_analytics.js` and `form.js` untouched." Branch diff (`git diff origin/develop -- server/priv/static/form.js`, 5 insertions): "+    errorEl.style.display = \"flex\";" and "+      errorEl.style.display = \"\";" in showInlineError/clearInlineError.
detail: The display:flex preflight fix was deliberately pulled into the PR (deferred-work.md records this: 'the deferred one-liner was pulled into the PR'), but the spec's own boundary and verification sections never acknowledge the deviation from a frozen constraint.
recommended_fix: Add one line to the spec's Design Notes (outside the frozen block) recording the scoped form.js exception and its Perkins r1 provenance.
